evidence: 1) Policy: task/tests/scoring.toml:1-11 is byte-identical to the frozen template (diff empty; sha256 95f70d6e...): [gates] render = 0.0, constraints = 0.0; [weights] functional 0.6, polish 0.2, visual 0.2; [floors] functional = 0.05. Gate dimensions appear only in [gates], never in [weights], so they carry no reward mass. Gate judge.toml files use aggregation = "all_pass" (render/constraints judge.toml:15) with one binary criterion each (hro_gate_render, hro_gate_shared); their per-criterion weight = 1 only feeds all_pass and is not reward mass. 2) Mechanism: task/tests/tools/score.py and test.sh are byte-identical to the template (score.py sha256 13de2b38..., test.sh bd682592...). score.py:40-48: gates_passed = all(scores[k] > floor); scored_ran = gates_passed and scored_data is not None; weighted dims forced to 0.0 when not scored_ran; reward = weighted only if gates_passed and floors_passed else 0.0; returns exit 1 on gate failure. test.sh:212-227: rm scored dir, run gates suite (budget 1500), run score.py; exit 1 -> 'exit 0' (detailed zero record kept, scored suite never launched); other errors -> write_zero_reward; only exit 0 proceeds to run_suite scored 11100. Gate rewardkit failure/timeout also exits 0 with the pre-written zero (test.sh:60,213-214). 3) Actual execution (my run, scratchpad log dirs only, python -I -B on the frozen score.py): gate render 0 with a perfect scored/reward.json present -> reward 0.0, functional/polish/visual forced 0.0, exit 1; constraints 0 -> reward 0, exit 1; gates pass but no scored record -> reward 0; functional 0.049 or exactly 0.05 with polish=visual=1 -> reward 0.0 (floors_passed 0, weighted 0.43 not paid); full -> 1.0. 4) Farming: polish criteria (5, weight 9.5) all require live multi-user updates/sessions, so a non-working app cannot earn them; every scored prompt repeats the shared-save browser gate and assigns binary0/Likert-1(=0) on its failure (visual/prompt.md:9-12, polish prompt 'Global browser gate'). Functional has 44 criteria totalling weight 61, max single weight 2 (0.033), so no single criterion clears the 0.05 floor; at least ~3.1 weight points (>=2-3 passing functional criteria beyond the gate) are needed. 5) Colderwater lessons bearing on this row checked: lesson 2 (weights untouched — scoring.toml identical to template, criterion weights in the documented 1/1.5/2 scheme); lesson 4 (gates simple) — constraints gate is load/add/reload/independent-context readback, i.e. server-backed; render gate adds a wrong-password-refused leg, which is a stated sign-in expectation (instruction.md:19 single shared password; hireops_rules.md:11) and cheap for any real login, so not a hidden requirement, but it is extra gate strictness beyond load/reload/server-backed (see Note-level residual below); lesson 11 (judge infra crash zeroes a dimension) — gate prompts map tool failure to binary0 'NOT EXERCISED', which under all_pass zeroes the whole reward; this is template behaviour and bears on evidence interpretation, not on row 43's mechanism.
notes: Plausible broken app tried: a polished shell that signs in and saves one shared card (passes both gates) plus 401 on anonymous replays and Observer refusals (hro_add_candidate 1 + hro_anonymous 1.5 + hro_observer_readonly 1 = 3.5/61 = 0.057 functional) clears the 0.05 floor; executed score.py with functional 0.0574, polish 0, visual 0.75 -> reward 0.1844. This app is partially working (auth, shared add, role checks), not a non-working app, and its Visual score would likely be lower because conversations/activity views it lacks are graded; the floor value is template-controlled shared reward policy (identical to template and staged-task-contract.md), so it must not be changed task-side. Recorded as residual for rows 39/40/42/44, not a row-43 defect. Conforming alternative that could fail: an app with correct sign-in that does not show an explicit refusal still passes render (refusal message 'welcome but not required'); an app where the Observer cannot see the board would fail the constraints gate, but the brief makes Observer read the board (hireops_rules.md:19), and another working staff account is accepted.
